summary.en: Sonoko invites Ran to a party held by real estate company manager Kensaku Takada, and Conan inevitably has to follow them since Kogoro is off to drink with the neighborhood association. At the party, they get to meet Kensaku and his wife, Konomi. Kensaku, who heard from Sonoko that Ran is a karate champion, says that he also once practiced karate in college, and out of his passionate talking, starts striking poses. While not mentioned by anyone, Kensaku’s sleeves pull up slightly during this talk, revealing an expensive-looking watch.

victims.name: Kensaku Takada
victims.causeOfDeathZh: 跌落后头部钝器伤致死

suspects: Konomi Takada, Rika Yamazato & Satoru Yoshioka
